Quote Card Maker

Design shareable 1080×1080 quote cards: your quote and author, six styled themes, live preview, and a real PNG download.

Quote Card Maker

1080×1080 quote cards for social media — live preview, one-click PNG download.

Live preview

📖 How to use

  1. Type your quote and the author's name.
  2. Pick one of the six themes.
  3. Preview the 1080×1080 card live.
  4. Click "Download PNG" to save the card.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What size is the exported card?

The card renders at 1080×1080 pixels — the standard square size for Instagram and Facebook posts.

How do I make a card?

Type the quote and author, pick a theme, and the preview updates instantly. Download when it looks right.

What if my quote is long?

Long quotes wrap automatically across multiple lines; keep it under ~200 characters for the best typography.
